events.title: Last weekend of Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: It's the last weekend of Steam Next Fest! The Banana Airways demo is free on Steam. Banana Airways reached the top 20 demos of Steam Next Fest by players online at the same time (out of 7,000+), with over 1,000 people playing at once. Thanks to everyone who flew with us! Grab up to 5 friends, fix the plane, serve the coffee and keep an eye on the baby. Leave him alone and he might take the controls :) If you had fun, a wishlist helps us a ton during Next Fest :)

events.summary: This update is live now in the free Banana Airways demo. 🏅 Early Adopter Badge Already beat the game? Jump in and claim yours: it's waiting for you on the main menu. events.title: We hit the top 25 demos of Steam Next Fest by concurrent players!
events.summary: Hi everyone! We're Eggscape Entertainment, the team making Banana Airways in Argentina. Banana Airways reached the top 25 demos of Steam Next Fest by players online at the same time (out of 7,000+), with over 1,000 people playing at once. Like Overcooked on a plane, with chickens that can turn radioactive. Online co-op for up to 6. Play the free demo at Steam Next Fest. Thanks to everyone who tried the demo, shared a video or left a comment. And a special thank you to our players in China!! Bana

events.title: Live: we're playing the Banana Airways demo
events.summary: Hey! We're streaming the Banana Airways demo all through Next Fest. It's just gameplay, no commentary: real flights with the crew, coffee runs, panels flying off the plane and the occasional cannibal chicken. If it looks like fun, the demo is free right here on this page and you can bring up to five friends. If you like what you see, a wishlist helps us a ton. See you on board!

events.title: Next Fest: don’t throw the baby off the plane. Even if it’s on fire.
events.summary: We made a co-op airline game. But the joke isn’t really the cheap flights. Your passengers are mutant chickens and they eat each other. We spent a lot of time getting that right :) You can yell at your friend for help. If they’re out on the wing fixing the engine, they won’t hear you. Proximity voice chat. You’ll have to go outside and tell them yourself. Banana Airways debuts at Steam Next Fest, Oct 19-26! Free demo playable now: online co-op for up to 6. https://store.steampowered.com/app/4900

events.title: Banana Airways demo is out: co-op for up to 6
events.summary: The Banana Airways demo is out, and it's free! You're the cabin crew of the worst low-cost airline in the sky. One of you flies the plane, another fixes the engine out on the wing, another serves coffee while the cabin is on fire. The passengers are cannibal chickens, some of them turn radioactive, and in the end a baby is flying the plane. online co-op for up to 6 players proximity voice chat: out on the wing, nobody in the cockpit can hear you From October 19 to 26 we're part of Steam Next Fes
